mod.name: Placeable
config.placeable.option.placed_without_t: Allow placement on blocks without a top rim.
If enabled, plants may float and unknown bugs may occur!
config.placeable.option.hanging_bamboo.t: Bamboo can be placed under the bottom face of a block and hangs down from it. The column breaks when its ceiling is removed.
config.placeable.option.hanging_bamboo_l:
Mirrored: large leaves on the tip, small above it, bare stalk further up.
Full: large leaves on every segment.
None: bare stalk.
config.placeable.option.hanging_bamboo_g: Random ticks and bone meal grow hanging bamboo downward, up to 16 blocks like vanilla. When off, hanging bamboo never grows.
